chunks: And from him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “If you become forgetful in the Maghrib prayer, then repeat the salat (prayer).”

key_terms.سَهَوْتَ: you became forgetful or inattentive during prayer
key_terms.ٱلْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should be done if forgetfulness occurs in the Maghrib prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding forgetfulness in the Maghrib prayer. It indicates that if one commits sahw in Maghrib, the salat (prayer) is to be repeated, highlighting the special legal treatment of this prayer in fiqh.
